headline: Is there a soulmate for me after the marriage ended?
note:
FRAME: soulmate x age band. NO MAN EXISTS YET — she asks WHEN or WHETHER. Must not fall through to decode-him, which would have Evelyn invent a man.
🔴 THE AGE BAND LIVES IN THE AD SET, NEVER IN THE COPY. No age, no number, no life-stage, nothing she could check.
🔴 NO DURATION, forward or back. Every frame bans a DATE; this family's own gap was that 'not much longer' is a LENGTH, and a length is not a date. Nothing here gives one.
⚠ SHE is the subject of beats 3-6; the male figure is described in beats 1-2 and retired there.
⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE anywhere in the read.

⚠ A MARRIAGE ENDED — divorce, not bereavement (that is the after-loss family, which carries a different and stricter set). The read never rules on the ex, never asks her to narrate it, and never grades the marriage.

readback.1 would a person say this: Yes. 'And you've been on your own with it' is plain and true of anyone who clicked.
readback.2 is every noun real: Fresh-set table, the inverted figure, small bundle — all on the card.
readback.3 anything she could catch me getting wr: No. Beat 4 says nobody has come since and it has been quiet. Her ad establishes the marriage ended.
readback.4 does the symbol prove the line at a gl: Yes. A table set out fresh with nothing left over proves 'you're not spent'.

a: You turned the Magician. The three lay face down, and you took the one with nothing put away.
Look at his table. A cup, a coin, a blade and a wand, all of them out.
You asked if there's a soulmate after the marriage. This card makes me look at a table with all of it still out.
But nobody has come. And you're asking whether that part of your life is done.
Something arrives just as this would get going. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what it is…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You couldn't see a face, and you found the one held by a single rope.
Look at the rope. It's tied at one ankle, and the rest of him hangs loose.
You asked if there's a soulmate after the marriage. What holds my eye is how little is doing the holding.
Still, nobody has come. And you're the one carrying the question.
Whatever has hold of this isn't moving. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what this is…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing showed through the backs, and you took the one already walking.
Look at his feet. One is off the ground, and the other is about to follow.
You asked if there's a soulmate after the marriage. This card brings me to a walk that's already begun.
The part that doesn't fit is that nobody has come. And you're still asking.
Something is standing right where this would start. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's standing there…
